# Hairline custom figure kernel

Unmodified `kernel.js` from Lucas Marques' hairline-create skill:
https://github.com/lucasmarkes/hairline/tree/main/skills/hairline-create

MIT licensed; see LICENSE. Downloaded 2026-10-20.

UT1–UTC's globe is in `assets/figures/ut1utc/earth-time.js`; Greene's Counsel's
conversation is in `assets/figures/greene/counsel.js`; the graphic archive's
print tray is in `assets/figures/graphic-archive/print-tray.js`. The shared integration in
`js/hairline-thumbnails.js` mounts each figure and plays its declared tour;
Hairline controls springs, reduced motion, and off-screen pausing.
